blocks.h2: Gas Line Installation Questions From McHenry Homeowners

items.q: Can you run gas to a standby generator?
items.preview: Yes, sized to the generator's load.
items.answer: Yes. Generators draw a lot of gas, so we size the line to the generator and your other appliances.

items.q: Can you run a gas line to my detached garage?
items.preview: Yes, usually buried, with a shutoff at each end.
items.answer: Yes. We run the line, usually underground, with shutoffs and proper connections at the heater.

items.preview: New gas work usually requires one.
items.answer: New gas piping usually requires a permit. We'll explain what applies to your project.

items.q: How long does an installation take?
items.preview: Most are done in a day.
items.answer: Most residential gas line jobs are done in a day, including the pressure test.

items.q: Can you run gas to a pier or boathouse grill?
items.preview: Often, depending on distance and code.
items.answer: Often. It depends on the distance from the house, the route and what code allows. We'll look at the site and explain the options.

items.q: How much does gas line installation cost in McHenry?
items.preview: It depends on the run and the appliance. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the length of the run, the pipe size and the appliance. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
